Topic 14.1: Listening and Speaking 14.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 14.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: which How do we pronounce words with the target letter-sound combinations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 14.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to speak clearly and correctly is improved as they use the new words learnt to talk about

talents.

• Communication and collaboration: Teamwork is encouraged as the learner actively participates in playing language game with peers observing the

rules of engagement.

Values:
Social justice is enhanced as the learner fosters inclusivity and non-discrimination to peers as they play language games.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (Self-awareness): The learner’s self-awareness is developed as they become aware of their own talents.

Link to other Learning Areas

The learner applies attentive listening skills in learning of concepts in other learning areas.
